name: Gratuity Calculator UAE 2026 (MoHRE Updated)
author: fazalniazi

sections.description:
Gratuity Calculator UAE 2026 (MoHRE Updated) is the most complete and easy-to-use gratuity calculator plugin for WordPress. Whether you are an employee, HR professional, employer, or accountant working in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, or any other emirate — this plugin gives you instant, accurate gratuity calculations based on the official UAE Labour Law 2026.

Calculate your UAE Gratuity for FREE:
Gratuity Calculator UAE

Use the shortcode [gratucalc_calculator] to display the calculator on any page or post in seconds.

What is UAE Gratuity?

UAE Gratuity, also known as End of Service Benefit (EOSB), is a mandatory payment that every employer in the UAE must pay to an employee at the end of their employment. It is governed by the UAE Federal Labour Law and applies to all employees working under a UAE employment contract — whether in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, or Umm Al Quwain.

Why is UAE Gratuity Important?

Thousands of employees across the UAE — including Pakistani, Indian, Filipino, Bangladeshi, Egyptian, and other expatriate workers — are entitled to gratuity payments when they leave a job. Many workers lose out on their rightful gratuity because they do not know the exact calculation method. This free plugin solves that problem by automating the entire calculation process.

Employers also benefit because they can plan their End of Service liability in advance, avoiding disputes and ensuring they meet their legal obligations under UAE Labour Law 2026.

How the Gratuity Calculator UAE Works (MoHRE 2026 Rules):

  • Less than 1 year of service: No gratuity is payable.
  • 1 to 5 years of service: 21 days of basic salary for each year of service.
  • More than 5 years of service: 21 days per year for the first 5 years, PLUS 30 days per year for every year after 5 years.
  • Maximum gratuity cap: Total gratuity cannot exceed 2 years of basic salary.

Important Rules Under UAE Labour Law 2026:

  1. Gratuity is calculated on the basic salary only — not on allowances such as housing, transport, or food.
  2. If an employee resigns before completing 1 year, no gratuity is due.
  3. If an employee resigns after 1 year but before 3 years, they receive 1/3 of the gratuity.
  4. If an employee resigns after 3 years but before 5 years, they receive 2/3 of the gratuity.
  5. If an employee resigns after 5 years or is terminated, they receive full gratuity.
  6. Under the new UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021), fixed-term contracts have replaced unlimited contracts for most workers.

For a complete and detailed gratuity calculation, visit:
https://gratuitycalculatruae.com

Key Features:

  • 100% Free — No subscriptions, no hidden fees, no premium version required
  • MoHRE 2026 Updated — Fully follows the latest UAE Labour Law rules
  • Mobile Responsive — Works perfectly on all devices
  • Lightweight — Fast loading, zero performance impact
  • Easy Shortcode — [gratucalc_calculator] — add to any page in seconds
  • Beginner Friendly — No coding required
  • Page Builder Compatible — Works with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, and all major builders
  • Translation Ready — Supports Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, and other languages
  • Regular Updates — Kept current with the latest UAE Labour Law changes

Who Should Use This Plugin?

  1. UAE Employees — Know your exact end of service entitlement before resigning
  2. HR Professionals — Calculate gratuity for multiple employees quickly and accurately
  3. Employers and Business Owners — Plan your End of Service liability and avoid disputes
  4. Accountants and Finance Teams — Automate gratuity calculations for payroll
  5. Legal Advisors and PROs — Quick reference tool during employee settlements
  6. Educational Websites — Embed on HR and labour law resource sites

Gratuity Calculator UAE — Practical Examples:

Example 1:
Basic salary: AED 5,000/month | Years of service: 3 years
Gratuity = 21 days x 3 = 63 days | Daily salary = AED 166.67
Total Gratuity = AED 10,500

Example 2:
Basic salary: AED 8,000/month | Years of service: 7 years
First 5 years: 21 x 5 = 105 days | Next 2 years: 30 x 2 = 60 days
Total = 165 days | Daily salary = AED 266.67
Total Gratuity = AED 44,000

For instant results, use the free online calculator at:
https://gratuitycalculatruae.com

This plugin references gratuitycalculatruae.com for detailed gratuity calculations and UAE Labour Law guidance.

  • Privacy Policy: https://gratuitycalculatruae.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, OR install directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the shortcode [gratucalc_calculator] to any page or post.
  4. Publish the page — your Gratuity Calculator UAE is ready!

Installation via WordPress Admin:

  1. Go to Plugins -> Add New
  2. Search for “Gratuity Calculator UAE”
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Add shortcode [gratucalc_calculator] to any page
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, 100% free with no hidden charges, no premium upsells, and no subscription required.

Is the calculation accurate for UAE Labour Law 2026?

Yes. The plugin follows the official UAE Federal Labour Law and MoHRE 2026 regulations. For the most up-to-date calculation, also visit https://gratuitycalculatruae.com

Which emirates does this plugin cover?

All seven emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, fully mobile responsive and works on all screen sizes.

Can I use it with Elementor or other page builders?

Yes. Add the shortcode [gratucalc_calculator] inside any Shortcode widget in Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, or any other builder.

What is UAE Gratuity?

UAE Gratuity (End of Service Benefit) is a mandatory payment under UAE Labour Law, paid to employees who complete at least one year of continuous service. Learn more at https://gratuitycalculatruae.com

How is gratuity calculated in UAE?

First 5 years: 21 days basic salary per year.
After 5 years: 30 days basic salary per year.
Maximum: 2 years total basic salary.
Use the free calculator at https://gratuitycalculatruae.com for instant results.

Is gratuity calculated on basic salary or total salary?

Gratuity is calculated on basic salary only — not on housing, transport, food, or other allowances.

What happens to gratuity if an employee is terminated?

If terminated (not for misconduct), the employee is entitled to full gratuity after completing at least 1 year of service.

Where can I calculate UAE gratuity online for free?

Visit https://gratuitycalculatruae.com — free Gratuity Calculator UAE online.
